description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The unique ID of the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.

description.zh: 传入的参数作为更新后的备注，传空值则删除备注。
description.en: The new remarks for the address. To delete the remarks, leave this parameter empty.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-remark --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
